_comment: Servo geometry for the CAD export, in the servo frame used by goik_cad.py:
origin on the horn axis at the outer face of the horn, +Z out of the horn, case extending along -X.
case: length (along X), width (along Y), depth (along Z, behind the horn), axis_from_end (horn axis to the near end of the case).
vendor_step: optional vendor model in cad/vendor/. 'transform' maps the vendor file's coordinates to the servo frame
(row major 4x4). While it is null, the simple case + horn geometry is used. See docs/servo-models.md.

AX-12A.source: Measured on the ROBOTIS AX-12 model (python cad/tools.py measure and a survey of its features), matching the ROBOTIS drawing: case 32 x 50 mm, 32 mm thick, horn diameter 22 mm standing 5.7 mm proud of the case, horn axis centred and 11.5 mm from the near end, idler hub on the other side 3 mm proud

mounting._comment: Servo frame coordinates (origin on the horn face, +Z out of the horn, case along -X). Used for the printable brackets

XL-320.source: Measured on the ROBOTIS XL-320.step (python cad/tools.py measure): case 24 x 36 mm, 27 mm deep including the 3 mm horn, horn diameter 17.8 mm, horn axis centred across the width and 9 mm from the near end

STS3215.source: Measured on Waveshare's ST3215.step (python cad/tools.py measure and a survey of its features): case 45.22 x 24.72 mm, 33.1 mm between the mounting faces, horn diameter 19.2 mm, horn axis 10.11 mm from the near end. Overall depth 37.8 mm including the horn and the disc on the back

mounting._comment: Measured on Waveshare's ST3215.step. 8 mounting holes for self-tapping M2 screws (1.6 mm) in the case walls, 4 on each side, with different positions on the two sides. The back has a disc with the same 4-screw pattern as the horn (radius 7 mm, 2.5 mm holes: probably M3, check with the real servo). The horn and the disc stand only about 2 mm proud of the case, so the arms stand off them by 3 mm to leave room for 4 mm plates
